name: graph-first-gate
description: Enforce the rules document instead of trusting the model to follow it: source files may not be read before the code graph has been consulted. Ported from the reference implementation that has been running on the authors' own machines.
reminder:
[system-reminder · code-graph rule · enforced by a gate, not by request]
Before reading source files, consult the code graph:
  Layer 1  ask the graph: search_graph / trace_path / get_code_snippet / query_graph / get_architecture / search_code
  Layer 2  if the repository is not indexed, or the index is older than the code, build it first (index_repository), then return to Layer 1
  Layer 3  read specific lines only when the graph genuinely cannot answer (non-code files, files you wrote yourself this session)
One successful graph query opens this gate for the rest of the session. Skipping Layer 1/2 is blocked at the tool level.
